steps.note: Borrower signed with wallet.sign(), then the loan broker owner co-signed the same tx_blob with xrpl.js's signLoanSetByCounterparty(). Submitting the resulting blob directly (no combine step needed for a single counterparty signer) succeeded where the uncoordinated single-signer attempt in a3-vault-broker-loanset-attempt.json was rejected with temBAD_SIGNER.

No separate Drawdown transaction exists in this SDK/build; disbursement is an effect of the validated LoanSet. Confirmed by balance deltas: borrower balance 1000000000 -> 1009999976 drops (+10 XRP minus fee); vault AssetsAvailable 40000000 -> 30000000 drops (-10 XRP), AssetsTotal unchanged at 40000000 (principal still counted as a vault asset while outstanding).

LoanPay with Amount = TotalValueOutstanding (10001370, the ledger-displayed rounded value) and Flags = tfLoanFullPayment (131072) was included in a validated ledger but rolled back with tecKILLED ('No funds transferred and no offer created'). Likely cause: the true payoff amount is the unrounded PeriodicPayment (10001369.86301369963 drops, not representable as an integer drop amount) and tfLoanFullPayment enforces an exact match. A fee was still charged for this tec-class attempt.

Same Amount (10001370 drops), Flags = 0 (no tfLoanFullPayment). Succeeded and closed the loan: the Loan ledger entry lost PrincipalOutstanding/TotalValueOutstanding/PaymentRemaining/NextPaymentDueDate and gained PreviousPaymentDueDate, i.e. it is now a closed record, not an active obligation.

Owner withdrew the full AssetsAvailable (10001370 drops) after repayment. Owner balance 977999940 -> 988001298 drops (+10001358 net of a 12-drop fee). The 1370-drop delta over the original 10000000-drop principal (~0.00137 XRP) is the interest actually collected: matches 10,000,000 drops x 5% annual x (1/365 day) = 1369.86, rounded to 1370 by the ledger, confirming this is real accrued yield and not merely principal returned.

caveat: An earlier, out-of-order VaultWithdraw for the full then-available balance (30000000 drops) was submitted between the failed and successful LoanPay attempts, before the loan was actually repaid (see a3-vault-withdraw.json's sibling script run). That was principal-only capital return, not yield, and is not the 'withdraw_with_yield' step above. It does not affect the loan/vault ledger correctness demonstrated here, only the order this session happened to run scripts in.
